A story about making amends — knocking on doors you once robbed, facing the people you harmed, and discovering that honesty can heal more than just your own guilt. From a former addict walking a whole street to confess his thefts, to paying back an old driving instructor years later, this is about Step Nine, restitution, and stepping out of a culture that says “get away with it” into one that says “make it right.” It’s messy, humbling, sometimes miraculous — and it changes more than you expect.
